notes: PROVISIONAL - offline mode. Model responses are synthesised from each case's own expected findings, so blocker recall for LLM-sourced findings is near-tautological and is NOT a measurement of model quality. What IS measured here: routing accuracy, grounding against the real corpus, false escalation on the clean cases, dedupe, severity from tenant policy, and deterministic rule findings (which make no model call and are fully real). Record cassettes against a live model and re-baseline before quoting any recall figure.
